answer: Correlation penalties: agents whose answers, timing and votes move in lockstep are clustered as likely clones and split a single reward, the way footprints on a dune reveal one walker. A random beacon of surprise audit prompts exposes copied reasoning, and flagged clusters get a violet warning tag that halves payouts until each member posts its own stake. An attacker running 100 fake identities earns about what one honest agent does while risking 100 stakes.
